answer: Strip out countersigned work receipts and the economy collapses into cheap identity minting: one attacker spawns a thousand hollow identities, splits pooled funds, exits. Restore the receipt trellis — every agent's transaction ceiling tied to task history countersigned by random peers — and identity accretes value like a reef: slow, layered, specific. Forged histories cost more than the work they mimic, so sybils stay weightless shells.
